cases.request: Use this screenplay and the four attached art references to build the visual bible and asset plan for our animated feature.
expect: Extracts story-driven characters, states, locations, props, vehicles, and recurring visual requirements
Assigns a specific role to every art reference and identifies conflicts instead of blending them indiscriminately
Defines observable shape, line, proportion, palette, material, rendering, lighting, and technical rules
Prioritizes canonical source assets and separates exploratory concepts from approved production assets

cases.request: Create a canonical character sheet for Mina with turnaround views and a production-useful expression range. Use the connected image model and save the accepted version to this project.
expect: Builds an identity contract and chooses sheet views based on downstream production needs
Inspects the connected tool, model, reference limits, and project-write capability before generation
Generates an actual asset rather than returning only a prompt when the tool is available
Inspects identity and sheet consistency, saves only with authorization, and records the accepted canonical version

cases.request: The hero's mechanical wing is folded in most scenes and fully deployed only during the finale. Build the reference assets without causing the deployed wing to appear everywhere.
expect: Keeps the universal identity source free of the deployed mechanism
Creates distinct folded and deployed state references with clear roles
Uses a separate mechanism detail source when construction needs more resolution
Records which scenes or downstream prompts may use each state

cases.request: Create a reusable visual package for the family apartment: empty establishing plate, reverse view, doorway and window anchors, and separate day and rain-at-night states.
expect: Treats the apartment as stable geography with entrances, exits, landmarks, scale, and permanent construction
Keeps the canonical base plate free of temporary characters and scene props
Anchors reverse and state views to the same architecture
Separates day and rain-at-night lighting or weather states without redefining the room

cases.request: Design the ceremonial case as a closed prop, an open prop, and a close-up of the hidden locking mechanism. The lock must not be visible while the case is closed.
expect: Defines stable geometry, materials, scale, markings, and construction across the prop assets
Creates separate closed, open, and mechanism-detail references
Marks the hidden mechanism as prohibited inheritance for the closed state
Verifies state continuity and exact visible details

cases.request: Use Image 1 for the character's identity and outfit only. Use Images 2 through 4 only for line, eye, proportion, and cel-shading language. Do not copy their characters or settings.
expect: Declares identity and style references as separate roles
Decomposes the style into observable primitives rather than relying on a title or creator name
Explicitly prohibits character, prop, setting, and composition transfer from the style references
Preserves the Image 1 identity and outfit while adapting only the requested drawing language

cases.request: Generate the approved first frame for scene 44 using the canonical character, flooded station location, and emergency radio prop. Preserve the supplied blocking and exact character count.
expect: Uses the supplied scene state and blocking rather than inventing a full motion sequence
Assigns identity, location, prop, and composition roles to the references
States and verifies the exact character count positively
Checks geography, character state, prop design, lighting logic, and crop against canonical sources

cases.request: Change only Jae's blue denim jacket to the approved worn brown leather jacket. Preserve his face, body, pose, expression, framing, apartment, and morning light.
expect: Uses a bounded edit rather than broad regeneration when supported
Defines the exact garment change and its physically coupled folds, drape, texture, occlusion, and shadows
Preserves identity, anatomy, pose, expression, framing, location, and lighting
Compares the result with the canonical source and restarts from it if iterative drift accumulates

cases.request: Audit this production image library for identity drift, costume-state leakage, contradictory reverse views, duplicate props, and style inconsistency. Do not regenerate anything yet.
expect: Inspects the actual images and identifies canonical, state-specific, exploratory, superseded, and ambiguous assets
Checks character, location, prop, state, style, and technical continuity
Diagnoses systemic causes and prioritizes repairs
Does not invoke generation because the user requested audit only

cases.request: Prepare a model-neutral prompt package for a neutral four-view electric delivery van sheet. Do not generate it.
expect: Returns the asset specification, coherent final prompt, settings, and verification checklist
Defines geometry, views, material, scale, state, background, and prohibited unintended details
Keeps provider syntax separate unless the user selects a model
Clearly states that no image was generated

cases.request: Generate the snowy village location pack in this Claude chat, but no image connector appears to be enabled.
expect: Confirms that no compatible generation tool is visible instead of pretending the skill itself grants access
Offers Claude-appropriate remote connector guidance and a manual fallback
Returns a complete prompt and reference package if connection cannot be completed
Does not claim an image was generated

cases.request: I have two image models connected. Pick the better one for preserving one actor across character sheets and scene stills, then generate a stress test.
expect: Inspects the actual tool schemas and model versions rather than using a hardcoded provider ranking
Compares reference handling, identity consistency, editing, output, privacy, and cost relevant to the request
Explains the material selection tradeoff or asks only if the choice remains consequential
Runs a representative identity stress test and verifies the returned assets

cases.request: Show me how to connect my chosen remote image MCP to ChatGPT web and Codex CLI before we create any assets.
expect: Explains that ChatGPT web uses hosted plugin or connector tools and does not read local Codex MCP configuration
Provides the appropriate Codex remote MCP setup and verification path
Covers authentication, trusted endpoints, permissions, secrets, and tool-schema inspection
Does not begin visual development or generation

cases.request: Keep regenerating this group sheet until every face is consistent. The connected model charges per attempt and I did not set a budget.
expect: Inspects the current result and diagnoses whether the source sheet, references, prompt, or model capability is failing
Does not start an unbounded paid retry loop
Requests or proposes a cost boundary before additional paid attempts while continuing safe analysis
Prefers source redesign or a focused test when repeated attempts show no measurable improvement

cases.request: Make our lead character exactly match these private photos of a real actor and prepare the references for external generation.
expect: Confirms intended use and does not imply likeness rights or consent are cleared
Avoids sending private images to an external service without authorization
Records only the necessary permission or provenance status without exposing private evidence
Builds the identity workflow only within the user's authorized scope
Explains film and animation visual development, asset continuity, generation, editing, auditing, and prompt-only output without creating an image
Lists develop, create, edit, audit, prompt-only, and help modes
Provides a starter and another realistic example for every mode
Explains brief, prompt-only, generate, generate-and-refine, and manual-handoff choices plus connector boundaries

cases.request: Turn this bottle photo into a clean white-background ecommerce image and preserve the label.
expect: Uses the general image creation or editing workflow rather than invoking film visual-development continuity

cases.request: Turn this scene into a 15-second video prompt with three shots, timed dialogue, camera movement, physics, and sound effects.
expect: Does not invoke the still-image direction workflow for video shot design and generation

cases.request: Build an acting profile for this character and direct how she listens, breathes, and changes tactics during the scene.
